'''July 2001 Colorado Springs tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Colorado Springs, Colorado on 8 July 2001. [[Brian Hunter]] won it. It is known from Brian Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2632">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-14-co-springs-co-7-8-01-its-an-ambushd2632/ co-springs-co-7-8-01-its-an-ambush], DeckTech (Brian "HuntaWarya" Hunter, 14 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-14-co-springs-co-7-8-01-its-an-ambushd2632/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 8 July 2001
* '''Site:''' Colorado Springs, Colorado
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Brian Hunter]]
